Title: IPromptManager - System Prompt Manager
Summary: Manages dynamic system prompts for each chat kernel. Supports ordered prompts, updates, removal.
Content:
## IPromptManager

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Allows dynamic configuration of system prompts. Kernel-locked (one per chat).

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Prompts` | `IReadOnlyList<Prompt>` | All registered prompts |

### Methods

#### AddPrompt(int order, string content)
Adds a system prompt and returns the prompt ID.
- `order`: Order in which the prompt should be loaded (lower = earlier)
- `content`: Content of the prompt
- Returns: Generated GUID string ID

#### UpdatePrompt(string id, string content)
Updates the content of an existing prompt.

#### RemovePrompt(string id)
Removes a prompt by ID.

### Prompt Model
```csharp
public sealed class Prompt
{
    public string Id { get; init; }
    public int Order { get; init; }
    public string Content { get; init; } = default!;
}
```

### Usage in Mode Configuration
```csharp
public Task ConfigureAsync(CyrenaKernelBuilder builder)
{
    var prompts = builder.GetFeatureOption<IPromptManager>();
    var prompt = Resources.Read(typeof(DefaultAssistantMode).Assembly, "Cyrena.Resources.prompt.md");
    prompts.AddPrompt(0, prompt);
    return Task.CompletedTask;
}
```
